facts.fact: 盖赫里斯的旗舰「至高号」是凯萨斯舰队在飓风之战后新建的最新式主力舰。
facts.anchor: The Exalted was the newest capital vessel in the Kesathese fleet, commissioned after the Hurricane Wars.

facts.fact: 它此刻压在内纳瓦伦舰队的舷外支架飞艇上方，炮口已瞄准却还没有放出闪电。
facts.anchor: Now it loomed over the Dominion outriggers, an elliptical colossus of metalglass and black-and-silver sails, its cannons taking aim but not unleashing the lightning.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克告诉塔拉辛，若不去见父亲、不顺着他的意思，他就会毁掉她的舰队。
facts.anchor: If I don’t—if he is not humored—he’ll destroy your fleet.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克长久凝视塔拉辛，让她生出他正把她的脸一寸寸记下来的古怪感觉。
facts.anchor: Alaric stared at her for such a long time that she was left with the oddest impression that he was committing every inch of her face to memory.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛承认自己长期把自我价值系在「能给别人什么」上，因此也拿同一把尺子去量他。
facts.anchor: For so long my own self-worth was also tied to what I could offer others, and so I held you to that same standard.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克从士兵手里拿过镣铐，亲手把它们扣在塔拉辛的手腕上。
facts.anchor: The soldier gave him the restraints and he was the one who clapped them around Talasyn’s wrists.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛在被舱内黑暗吞没前最后看了一眼聚拢的星子，悄悄向女儿道别。
facts.anchor: As she took one last look at the gathering stars before the sky was replaced by the darkness within the bay, she quietly said goodbye to her daughter

facts.fact: 塔拉辛走进舱室后对王座上的盖赫里斯说出「我们终于见面了，公公」。
